Class RunnerResult

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.RunnerResult

  • public final class RunnerResult
extends java.lang.Object
    The result of a single Runner invocation.

    Instances are immutable. Build them with #builder(String, AIMetrics).
